title: Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Finnish Foreign Minister Valtonen
author: Office of the Spokesman
summary:
Office of the Spokesman

Secretary Rubio’s Meeting with Finnish Foreign Minister Valtonen

Readout

October 29, 2026

Secretary of State Marco Rubio met today with Finnish Foreign Minister Elina Valtonen to strengthen U.S.-Finland economic and security cooperation. The Secretary and the Foreign Minister signed the U.S.-Finland Technology Prosperity Deal and a Critical Minerals Framework Agreement to support technology collaboration and secure critical supply chains. Both leaders underscored the importance of cooperation on critical minerals and continued defense investment.
